name: Volt Serpent
description: Surge ahead for 3 seconds with a charged energy trail.

name: Inferno Viper
description: A short magma blast slows nearby rivals for 3 seconds.

name: Frost Fang
description: Leave an icy trail for 4 seconds that slows other serpents.

name: Cyber Reaper
description: A robotic shield absorbs one eligible collision within 4 seconds.

name: Shadow Phantom
description: Enter spectral form and pass through rivals for 2 seconds.

name: Solar Wyrm
description: Draw nearby energy toward your head for 4 seconds.

name: Neon Samurai
description: Make a rapid directional dash for 0.8 seconds. Collisions remain lethal.

name: Toxic Fang
description: Release a toxic cloud for 3 seconds that slows nearby rivals.
